spec_match.rationale: A real iframe fires periodic focus() steals and the parent reloads it with a real allow attribute per toggle — exactly the disruption pattern the directive exists to stop.

interactive.rationale: Allow/deny toggles drove iframe reloads and the timestamped log recorded policy changes, iframe-ready, and focus() events in the driven run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised typing-field focus-steal demonstration with a live policy toggle.

edge_cases.rationale: Allow vs deny is covered; header-delivery and sandbox variants are shown only as code comments.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 5 pass / 1 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: toggled deny then allow; log recorded 'policy changed to: deny/allow', iframe ready, and focus() firing; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Heavy CSS-variable usage (48 var() hits), no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Toggle buttons are native, but the event log and the typing field's stolen-focus state are not announced via live regions.

openQuestions.title: Announce focus steals via a live region
openQuestions.detail: The core demonstration — focus being yanked mid-typing — is currently visual-only; an aria-live assertive note when the iframe steals focus would convey the disruption non-visually.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: toggled deny/allow, saw the iframe reload with the corresponding allow attribute and the log record focus() calls from the frame; zero console errors; conformance panel honestly 5 pass / 1 fail.
